content.text: 我會用交易（transaction）一次完成搬移，包含課程、評量、點名、分校綁定與老師科目設定；有可能重複的表（像分校綁定）會採「去重合併」避免衝突。完成後我會再驗證 `id=58` 是否已清空。

input.command: php artisan tinker --execute="\$from=58; \$to=70; \$db=Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\DB::class; if(!\$db::table('User')->where('id',\$from)->exists()){ throw new Exception('source user not found'); } if(!\$db::table('User')->where('id',\$to)->exists()){ throw new Exception('target user not found'); } \$summary=[]; \$db::transaction(function() use (\$db,\$from,\$to,&\$summary){ foreach([['LearningRecord','TeacherID'],['StudentClass','TeacherID'],['StudentSingIn','TeacherID'],['auth_tokens','user_id'],['user_login_activities','user_id']] as [\$t,\$c]){ \$summary[\$t.'.'.\$c]=\$db::table(\$t)->where(\$c,\$from)->update([\$c=>\$to]); } foreach([['teacher_subjects',['subject_id']],['teacher_subject_levels',['subject_id','level_id']],['UserCampus',['CampusID']],['user_notification_preferences',['channel']]] as [\$t,\$keys]){ \$rows=\$db::table(\$t)->where('teacher_id',\$from); if(\$t==='UserCampus'){ \$rows=\$db::table(\$t)->where('UserID',\$from);} if(\$t==='user_notification_preferences'){ \$rows=\$db::table(\$t)->where('user_id',\$from);} \$items=\$rows->get(); \$moved=0; \$deleted=0; foreach(\$items as \$row){ \$where=[]; foreach(\$keys as \$k){ \$where[\$k]=\$row->{\$k}; } \$targetExists=false; if(\$t==='UserCampus'){ \$targetExists=\$db::table(\$t)->where('UserID',\$to)->where(\$where)->exists(); if(\$targetExists){ \$db::table(\$t)->where('id',\$row->id)->delete(); \$deleted++; } else { \$db::table(\$t)->where('id',\$row->id)->update(['UserID'=>\$to]); \$moved++; } } elseif(\$t==='user_notification_preferences'){ \$targetExists=\$db::table(\$t)->where('user_id',\$to)->where(\$where)->exists(); if(\$targetExists){ \$db::table(\$t)->where('id',\$row->id)->delete(); \$deleted++; } else { \$db::table(\$t)->where('id',\$row->id)->update(['user_id'=>\$to]); \$moved++; } } else { \$targetExists=\$db::table(\$t)->where('teacher_id',\$to)->where(\$where)->exists(); if(\$targetExists){ \$db::table(\$t)->where('id',\$row->id)->delete(); \$deleted++; } else { \$db::table(\$t)->where('id',\$row->id)->update(['teacher_id'=>\$to]); \$moved++; } } } \$summary[\$t.'.merge_moved']=\$moved; \$summary[\$t.'.merge_deleted']=\$deleted; } \$summary['User.status_inactivated']=\$db::table('User')->where('id',\$from)->update(['status'=>'inactive']); }); foreach(\$summary as \$k=>\$v){ echo \$k.'='.\$v.PHP_EOL; }"

content.text:
你說得沒錯，原本那個 `http://localhost/api/v1/line/webhook` 確實容易是錯的。

我已經修好後端產生網址邏輯（`backend/app/Http/Controllers/LineWebhookController.php`）：

- `line/status` 回傳 `webhook_url` 時，現在會：
  1) 先用分校 `Campus.URL`（如果有而且不是 localhost）  
  2) 再用 `APP_URL`（如果不是 localhost）  
  3) 最後才用目前請求的實際網域（你正在開這個頁面的網域）

這樣就不會再被固定成 localhost（除非你本身就是用 localhost 開系統）。

請你在「LINE 通知設定」頁面按一次「重新整理」，看 `Webhook 網址` 是否變成你的正式網址/IP。  
如果你要，我也可以順便幫你把各分校的 `Campus.URL` 一次補齊，之後顯示會更穩定。
